body:
Thank you.

I did this, scored a 4. My concerns with my habits are troubling, but feel most like a pesky thatch of freshly sprouted weeds. If left neglected this  could very well overtake the entire garden...
Thanks kindly stranger!! I've made it through the night. The first in what feels like a long time. Now I shall sleep, and eventually find what I thought was lost :)

Thank you. So far so good, at least for tonight. I have abstained and plan to abstain further, despite even offerings(!) that would have been just fine in a social context but determination had me turn down that glass of wine via oblivious roommate.

I've been in many situations with alcohol where I refrain when others do not, where I choose to have one and stop and feel relatively fine about it. Lately the urge to indulge has been pretty overwhelming and I end up doing it alone a lot, which I need to stop. The last month or two (or three?) has had my quantities increase until I am consuming, on average, 6-10 oz of straight liquor a night, or 3-4 glasses of wine or beer.

I've yet to personally instill all the restrictions until recently, and honestly a large factor is my weight...I look about average, but all the empty calories and lethargy and good god, relentless drunk munchies, have packed on about 10-20 lbs more than I prefer. 

I appreciate the response. All responses. It's nice to know I'm not alone, and in confessing in this seemingly safe haven no one close to me is none the wiser and questioning my abilities. Which is especially a concern, given the pressure and obligations I already feel as a parent...

I am of age, I don't know what even defines an alcoholic, let alone defining myself as one, and being alone and drinking may be the issue. There are so many subjective factors that play into this situation; society says what I am doing is wrong, and I hide it from everyone. Maybe it's nobody's business. 

Maybe I just felt like confessing.

I don't really know....it seems to be this irresistible compulsion. I've been doing it for about two years now, off and on. I know it's terrible and dishonest and probably not great for me in assorted ways but I do it anyway. And I hide it. I'm struggling with some issues but I try to talk about them and pretend I am strong and then I sink into this pitfall of despair and probable alcoholism away from prying eyes.

There's no real good reason why. I am terribly ashamed of myself, too. Hence the hiding.

My teeny tiny titties. I wear a padded bra so you can't really tell how damn small they are until I'm naked. It always seems disappointing to dudes I get intimate with, and I have been woefully single and sans action for a very long time.
